findings.description: CH-27 incorrectly claims that injecting argon at constant volume and temperature produces an equilibrium shift toward ammonia because it raises the total pressure.
findings.proposed_fix:
<<<< SEARCH /Users/georgejackson/CDSFL_review_targets/exp48_chemistry.md
CH-27. Injecting argon into the converter at constant volume and constant temperature raises the total pressure in the vessel. Because Le Chatelier's principle predicts that a system under raised pressure moves to the side with fewer moles of gas, this injection produces an equilibrium shift toward ammonia, and the argon bleed is therefore used as a fine trim on converter yield.
==== REPLACE
CH-27. Injecting argon into the converter at constant volume and constant temperature raises the total pressure in the vessel. However, because the partial pressures of the reacting gases remain unchanged, this injection produces no equilibrium shift, and the argon bleed cannot be used to trim converter yield.
>>>>
